name: Gradiant 5G Charts
description: Helm charts for 5G technologies including Open5GS, UERANSIM, srsRAN, PacketRusher, and OAI gNB. Automatically built and pushed to DockerHub via GitHub Actions.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Helm charts automatically built and pushed to Gradiant DockerHub. Charts for open5gs, ueransim-gnb, srs-lte, srsran-5g-zmq, packetrusher. Kubernetes-native deployment.

eval_notes: Best integration hub for Open5GS — pre-configured with srsRAN, UERANSIM, PacketRusher, OAI gNB. SCP (Service Communication Proxy) support since v2.2.0. Great for automated testing pipelines. Kubernetes-ready Helm charts for all major RAN simulators. Enables quick deployment of different RAN+core combinations. Good for comparing simulator behavior across different tools.
